compiler: Native MSYS2 GCC 16.2.0-4 (g++.exe), hosted on Linux through Wine 9.0
abi_policy: Compiler, C++ standard headers, CRT/import libraries, and runtime DLLs are all taken from the same MSYS2 MINGW64 prefix. No host MinGW compiler is used.
link_step: Same native GCC16 g++.exe links the 42 compiled objects with -shared and --out-implib, then installs libqalculate-23.dll plus libqalculate.dll.a; this avoids host libtool misidentifying the Wine compiler wrapper.
provenance: Dependency and toolchain input metadata. Application builds and runtime validation require separate evidence.
